Game Overview

In Raccoon Retail, the core idea is straightforward: raccoon Retail transforms the chaotic charm of retail into a fun challenge. Step into a raccoon's paws, cleaning a bustling store with mischievous customers. Navigate spills, collect trash, and upgrade your cleaning gear as the aisles expand. Can you out-clean the messiest critters around? It's a wild, whimsical ride!
